steps.say: The Rendering Hall. Vats the size of houses, and the heat of them on your face like a hand.
On the racks by the nearest vat hang pilgrim robes. Dozens. Hundreds. Each one has a tag, and each tag has a name.
Carts full going in. Carts empty going out. Tallow stacked to the rafters, stamped with the Abbey's candle.
The Tallow in your pouch is warm. It always has been.
